issue.description: The units leave {{from}} and come in at {{to}} at once. Batches nearest expiry come first.
issue.noStock: No stock in date at the store for: {{items}}.

issue.moreThanBatch: No more than the batch has.

end.rejectDescription: Nothing is issued. Whoever asked sees why.
end.closeDescription: Nothing more is issued on it. What was issued stays.

refused.conflict: Someone changed this indent meanwhile. Close this and open it again to see what they saved.
refused.notOpen: This indent is not waiting to be issued.
refused.own: Someone else approves or rejects an indent you asked for.
refused.notRequester: Only whoever asked can withdraw an indent.
refused.overIssue: That is more than the item still has to issue.
refused.insufficient: A batch has fewer units at the store than that now.
refused.place: One of the places is no longer in use.
